Class RaceResult

java.lang.Object
RaceResult
public class RaceResult extends Object
Stores information about a driver's performance in a Formula 1 Grand Prix.

  • Constructor Details

    • RaceResult

      public RaceResult(int id, String driver, String team, String grandPrix, LocalDate date, int start, int finish, int points, double lap, boolean dnf)
      Creates a new Formula 1 race result containing driver information, race details, and performance statistics.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identification number for the race result
      driver - the name of the Formula 1 driver
      team - the name of the driver's racing team
      grandPrix - the name of the Grand Prix event
      date - the date when the race took place
      start - the driver's starting position in the race
      finish - the driver's finishing position in the race
      points - the championship points earned by the driver
      lap - the driver's fastest lap time in seconds
      dnf - indicates whether the driver did not finish the race
